2609.31511.title: Muslim: A Deployed Arabic Voice AI Platform for Grounded Islamic Knowledge
2609.31511.paper_summary: We present Muslim, a production Arabic voice AI platform serving grounded, sourced Islamic knowledge to real users. Beyond a real-time voice pipeline (NeMo Arabic ASR, an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint, self-hosted TTS) and a deterministic multi-source retrieval layer routed across six Model Context Protocol servers, we report three things a research prototype typically lacks. First, a released family of fine-tuned Arabic Islamic model artifacts: an efficient tool-routing LLM (Muslim-6B-PRO, 5.94B parameters) and a Modern Standard Arabic TTS model (Fasih-TTS-V1) that ranks 5th of 17 overall and 2nd of 11 open-weight systems on the community-voted Arabic TTS Arena for MSA. Second, an account and metering layer - a free per-account turn allowance, capacity-aware refusal, and email verification deferred to the point it actually matters - that turns an open demo into an operable, abuse-resistant product. Third, a three-layer observability stack (liveness, error reporting, product analytics) built specifically around the system's characteristic failure mode: a GPU-bound agent host going silent while the web tier keeps serving normally. We report real, measured latency and accuracy figures (98.4% recitation-validation accuracy on 124 cases; end-to-end voice latency of 0.9-1.7s) and discuss the concrete engineering trade-offs and limitations of running an Islamic-knowledge voice product in production.
2609.31511.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Muslim，一個提供基於真實來源的伊斯蘭知識的阿拉伯語語音 AI 平台，服務於實際用戶。除了實時語音管道（NeMo 阿拉伯語 ASR、一個與 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 端點、自我托管的 TTS）和一個確定性的多來源檢索層，該層通過六個模型上下文協議伺服器進行路由，我們報告了研究原型通常缺乏的三樣東西。首先，一系列已發布的微調阿拉伯語伊斯蘭模型工件：一個高效的工具路由 LLM（Muslim-6B-PRO，5.94B 參數）和一個現代標準阿拉伯語 TTS 模型（Fasih-TTS-V1），在社區投票的阿拉伯語 TTS Arena 中，總體排名第 5，開放權重系統中排名第 2。其次，一個帳戶和計量層 - 每個帳戶的免費回合配額、基於容量的拒絕，以及電子郵件驗證延遲到實際需要的時候 - 將一個開放的演示轉變為一個可操作的、抗濫用的產品。第三，一個三層可觀察性堆棧（實時性、錯誤報告、產品分析），專門圍繞系統的特徵性故障模式構建：一個 GPU 綁定的代理主機在網頁層正常服務的同時保持靜默。我們報告了真實的、測量的延遲和準確性數據（在 124 個案例中，98.4% 的誦讀驗證準確性；端到端語音延遲為 0.9-1.7 秒），並討論了在生產中運行伊斯蘭知識語音產品的具體工程權衡和限制。
2609.31511.author: Yahya Mohamed Elnawasany et.al.
